notes.coreModuleCompilations: the 285 MB core module is compiled once per page however many program instances and shard workers use it (measured 3 compilations for 3 instances before, 1 after)
notes.liveLinearMemoriesSettled: one program is open after the last Open File; every retired predecessor's instance and linear memory is collectable (measured 3 live memories, 333 MB, before; 1, 104 MB, after)
notes.perOpenRendererGrowthMB: renderer physical footprint after the last open minus after the one before it (measured +205 MB per open before the release fix, 0 to -100 MB after)
notes.settledTreeResidentMB: the warden's own measure (resident megabytes summed over the runner and the browser tree) after the opens settle: 512 MB below the 4,096 MB cap (measured 2,816 MB before, 2,244 to 3,129 MB after)
notes.rendererPeakFootprintMB: the kernel's lifetime peak physical footprint of the renderer (vmmap), the first-open transient included: 768 MB below the cap (measured 2,765 to 3,072 MB)
notes.component: the page opens the PDF 1.7 editor, whose app the descriptor's components map to semio-hub-stdio-pdf-1-7-editors: only that component's core module is fetched and compiled, never the 1.4 or viewer components (before round 6 the one component held all 20 apps)
